Create scripts in Go for the if the functionality is part of the OkResilience CLI implementation, never create a duplicate script that already exists, always enhance the existing scripts.
- Script should be idempotent and handle errors gracefully.
- Scripts should implement logging using a standard logging library.
- Scripts should include comments explaining the logic and flow of the code.
- Scripts should include integration tests to verify functionality.
- Each functionality or action should be modular and reusable.
- Try to write the less code possible to achieve the functionality.

Each time update the README.md file carefully to reflect the status of OkResilience in terms of how to build, execute on each scenario.

When updating README.md, ensure to:
- Include prerequisites for running the code.
- Provide clear setup instructions.
- Detail build and run commands.
- Never remove existing instructions unless they are obsolete.
